title: Photometric method for determining surface orientation from multiple images (Woodham)
core_method: classic Lambertian PS via shape-from-shading inversion
closest_similarity_to_ours: classic root of PS field
critical_difference: analytic; requires calibrated directional lights and known albedo ratio

title: The bas-relief ambiguity (Belhumeur-Kriegman-Yuille)
core_method: theory of uncalibrated PS ambiguity
closest_similarity_to_ours: classical uncalibrated-PS footing
critical_difference: theory only; no learned joint decomposition

title: A benchmark dataset and evaluation for non-Lambertian and uncalibrated photometric stereo (DiLiGenT)
core_method: benchmark dataset + evaluation protocol
closest_similarity_to_ours: our real-capture zero-shot benchmark
critical_difference: dataset not method; N=96 fixed; no learned model

title: Deep photometric stereo network (DPSN Santo et al.)
core_method: early deep PS with per-image feature aggregation
closest_similarity_to_ours: deep PS with N-input aggregation
critical_difference: calibrated; normals only; no albedo/lighting output

title: CNN-PS: CNN-based photometric stereo for general non-convex surfaces (Ikehata)
core_method: per-pixel fixed-size observation map + CNN
closest_similarity_to_ours: deep PS accuracy baseline
critical_difference: rigid fixed-N input; calibrated; normals only

title: PS-FCN: a flexible learning framework for photometric stereo (Chen-Han-Wong)
core_method: feature extraction per image + order-invariant max-pool fusion + normal prediction
closest_similarity_to_ours: HIGHEST on variable-N aggregation with uncalibrated promise
critical_difference: requires CALIBRATED light directions per image; normals only; no albedo/lighting; gray conversion common

title: Neural inverse rendering for general reflectance photometric stereo (MIRR Taniai-Maehara)
core_method: CNN autoencoder: per-image normal-to-illumination consistency + joint normal estimation
closest_similarity_to_ours: HIGH - joint normal+lighting from unknown lights with variable N
critical_difference: RGB synthetic training; no explicit albedo/depth output; small-scale lab evaluation; often cited as Neural Photometric Stereo (arXiv title) but venue is ICML 2018

title: Neural inverse rendering of an indoor scene from a single image (IRN Sengupta et al.)
core_method: self-supervised CNN factorizing single image into albedo+normals+envmap
closest_similarity_to_ours: reference for joint decomposition framing
critical_difference: single-image only; no multi-light evidence accumulation; no quantitative geometry on DiLiGenT-style objects

title: Self-calibrating deep photometric stereo networks (SDPS-Net Chen et al.)
core_method: two networks: LCNet light estimation + NENet normal regression
closest_similarity_to_ours: DANGEROUS - uncalibrated variable-N deep PS on DiLiGenT
critical_difference: no albedo/depth output; no joint BRDF factorization; normals-focused eval

title: SPLINE-Net: sparse photometric stereo via lighting interpolation and normal estimation (Zheng et al.)
core_method: lighting interpolation net densifies sparse observations then normal net
closest_similarity_to_ours: HIGH - sparse-light PS evidence accumulation
critical_difference: calibrated lights; normals only; no relighting of held-out lights

title: Learning to minify photometric stereo (Li et al.)
core_method: learned image-subset selection + normal prediction
closest_similarity_to_ours: related to few-image budget question
critical_difference: calibrated; normal-only; selection not aggregation theory

title: FacePSNet: lightweight PS for facial details (Wang et al.)
core_method: few-input face normal network
closest_similarity_to_ours: 3-image budget extreme case
critical_difference: face-specific; calibrated; normals only

title: Uncalibrated neural inverse rendering for photometric stereo of general surfaces (Kaya et al.)
core_method: iterative inverse-rendering CNN for uncalibrated PS
closest_similarity_to_ours: DANGEROUS - uncalibrated variable-N inverse rendering on DiLiGenT
